name: Chaos Ring
descriptionTemplate: At the start of exploration, increase the Relic Capacity by +1, and {Chaos} Awakener gains its "Dimensional Image". For each {Chaos} Awakener in the team, increase the Relic Capacity by +1.
lore: Chaos is formless, chaos is intangible; chaos has merged into all things.
